<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, which matches the characteristic 35Cl/37Cl isotopic ratio (≈3:1). The M+3 intensity (~4%) corresponds to the combined 13C+37Cl contribution, supporting the presence of chlorine. No other element shows a distinctive pattern (e.g., bromine would give M and M+2 of similar intensity). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
